title: Connect {logo}
to Gmail, Calendar
and Drive.
slides.subtitle: Three connections, three jobs to try this afternoon.

slides.label: 1. Connect your Google account
slides.detail: Open Claude settings, find Connectors, click Connect next to Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive, then sign in to Google and approve.
slides.start: Menu names move. Look for the word Connectors.

slides.label: 2. Gmail: sort your inbox
slides.detail: Paste: List emails from the last two days that need a reply from me, most urgent first. Draft replies to the top three and save them as drafts. Do not send.
slides.start: You read the drafts and press send yourself.

slides.label: 3. Calendar: find the time
slides.detail: Paste: Look at my calendar next week. Find three one-hour slots with 30 minutes either side, between 9am and 5pm, and tell me the busiest day.
slides.start: Then ask Claude to add the one you pick.

slides.label: 4. Drive: draft a quote
slides.detail: Paste: Find my price list and my three latest quotes in Drive. Write a new quote for [customer] for [job]. Show where each price came from and flag guesses.
slides.start: Check every figure against your own price list.

slides.label: What it could give back
slides.detail: Ten minutes a day hunting for emails, slots and files is 40 hours over 48 weeks. Halve that and it is about 20 hours. Illustrative, so time your own week.
slides.start: Start with the job that eats the most time.

slides.label: One thing to watch
slides.detail: Start with drafts and lists. Claude asks for your approval before sending email or sharing files by default, so leave that on.
slides.start: Check what your own plan shows.
